reviews.summary: Approve clip and sampler data, blend trees, state machines, IK, skinning, assembly, animation components/systems, and mechanical animation contracts; interpolation, transitions, hierarchy solving, palettes, and mechanical integration are exercised by the cited suites.
Review the morph-weight animation additions and public sampling helper used by the extended glTF importer.

Approve source/system/resource lifecycles and the spatial, procedural, ambience, impact, particle, storm, streaming, and vehicle audio contracts; resource ownership, synthesis parameters, deterministic event selection, spatial updates, and vehicle mixes are exercised by the cited suites.
Approve the public error taxonomy and assertion helpers; runtime error codes, inheritance, structured details, assertions, and boundary conversion behavior are pinned by the cited suite.

Approve capabilities, configuration, device-tier policy, engine lifecycle, events/disposables, logging, pools and handles, platform probes, snapshot helpers, and VERSION; package linkage and representative lifecycle, mutation, capacity, logging, probing, and snapshot behavior are pinned by the cited suites.

Approve task messages, registries, schedulers, worker-scope adapters, built-in handlers, and glTF mesh/animation task contracts; scheduling, cancellation, fallback, transfer, bundling, and glTF handling are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve wall, manual, and scripted clock contracts plus rate limiting; monotonic sampling, fixed-step catch-up and drop accounting, pause/scale/clamping, replay schedules, reset/interpolation, and cadence behavior are pinned by the cited suites.

Approve the developer console, frame profiler/timeline, and ECS, environment, GPU-resource, particle, physics, render-graph, streaming, and terrain inspection contracts; capture limits, filtering, aggregation, formatting, and debug geometry are exercised by the focused inspector suites.

Review the Phase 21 physics debug contact-overlay additions: bounded contact-point crosses and normal rays, optional colours/scales, and the body-pair metadata remain renderer-independent and read-only.

Approve atmosphere, clouds, cyclones, day/night, fog, lightning, moisture, scattering, ocean, snow, solar, sound-input, surface-weather, water, waterspout, weather, and wind-buffet contracts; deterministic updates, physical bounds, coupled systems, and rendering data are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve the coherent Forge 1.0 extension contract for systems, components, importers, terrain generators, materials, physics shapes, debug visualizers, and console commands; manifest validation, normalized catalog lookup, lifecycle disposal, snapshot metadata, and every registration category are exercised by the cited example and focused suite.

Approve GPU constants, format/layout helpers, buffer writing, device acquisition, and shader-cache contracts; alignment, limits, memory accounting, fatal-device handling, and shader validation are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve scalar, vector, matrix, color, geometry, BVH, noise, RNG, deterministic-math, double-precision-vector, and transform contracts; numerical bounds, determinism, intersections, hierarchy math, and random/noise behavior are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve particle layouts, components, emitters, modules, CPU/GPU worlds and systems, shader contracts, precipitation, trails, and lightning/vortex/waterspout/wind-blown visual helpers; spawn, simulation, packing, limits, and weather coupling are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve the public body/world/system, broad-phase, collision, solver, shape, component, backend, and WASM-memory contracts while retaining the nine separately tagged experimental exports; contact, query, integration, capacity, and vehicle coupling are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve scatter, LOD and culling, grass/tree/vegetation, settling, wind-sway, and population-world contracts; deterministic placement, packed GPU data, visibility and LOD selection, and vegetation updates are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve canonical population surfaces, worker task payloads/results, deterministic population task installation, and resident population raycast metadata; coarse/fine load-order parity, inline/worker parity, real worker execution and triangle picking are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve public geometry, material, mesh, cluster/light/object/population culling, pipeline, render-graph, renderer, primitive, shadow, skinning, scattering, splat, uniform, and shader contracts; graph ordering, frame execution, layouts, culling, shadows, pipelines, and WGSL are exercised by the cited suites.
Review the public morph geometry source and stable UV1 vertex layout used by glTF materials.

Approve replay channel, hashing, recording, and session contracts; serialization, validation, deterministic frame capture, state hashes, mismatch handling, and cross-engine reproduction are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve asset IDs/graphs/registries, glTF scene/mesh/texture handling, KTX2, texture resources, streaming, hot reload, and validation contracts; lifecycle, validation, transforms, handedness, mip policy, budgets, and reload behavior are exercised by the cited suites.
Review the extended glTF public decode contracts for morph targets, instancing, Draco and meshopt host seams.

Approve entity IDs, component stores and built-ins, coordinate spaces, render context, population state, scene/world/systems, serialization, snapshots, shadow limits, and surface grip contracts; ECS mutation, conversions, save/load, deterministic snapshots, and integration are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve script component/runtime, lifecycle, event, coroutine, timer, and hot-reload contracts; ordering, cancellation, ownership, error isolation, deterministic timing, and state transfer are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve budget/cache/chunk/LOD, coastal/deformation/generator/heightmap/horizon, interactions, materials, task, track/tire-weather, realistic-terrain, Mars-terrain, and terrain-world contracts; generation, seams, caching, deformation, tracks, grading, materials, collision interaction, and deterministic planetary staging are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve the mock GPU and mock audio helpers as supported consumer testing contracts; package linkage and their command, queue, resource, listener, and audio-node behavior are exercised by the runtime namespace, GPU, rendering, and audio suites.

Approve UI tree/context/geometry/color, animation, data binding/declarative APIs, diagnostics, GPU rendering, input/focus, layout, manager, assets/draw lists/painter, responsiveness, styles, text/localization, widget, overlay, and world-space contracts; layout, routing, rendering, styling, text, widget state, and animation are exercised by the cited suites.

Approve chassis, damage, drivetrain/electric, ground and physics-ground, loads, Pacejka tire, vehicle/component/system, and wheel-rig contracts; torque flow, motor limits, wheel contacts, tire forces, damage, suspension, integration, and collision behavior are exercised by the cited suites.
Review the dynamic vehicle chassis contract: the opt-in chassis type/mass/damping options and the fixed-step coupling that preserves the existing kinematic default.
